payload.token: uuid — the token taken off the map, when the command's target is its instance; when absent or null, the command's target is the token. Its partition is tombstoned (a soft delete) and nothing else is written: its initiative entry follows the aggregate's relations (initiativeEntryTokenId, cascade), the order closes up by itself (orderIndex, derived), and when the token holds the turn the caller sends table.nextTurn first, then this command
